import subprocess,json
probes=[]
for args in (['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=memory.used,utilization.gpu','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'],['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'],['pgrep','-af','benchmarks.analysis.cuda.run']):
 r=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 probes.append({'command':args,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr})
print(json.dumps(probes,indent=2))
